snippet.title: Arthur's Tale Story Teaser
snippet.description:
Steam Next Fest Demo Available Now!

Arthur's Tale is a nostalgic platformer about memories, family, and one final adventure.

Play as Arthur, an aging explorer who must travel through dangerous lands to save the fading memories of his granddaughter Elizabeth.

Demo Available Now on Steam

Features:
• 15 handcrafted levels
• 3 boss fights
• Secret areas to discover
• Story-driven cutscenes
• Classic platforming inspired by old-school adventures

Wishlist Arthur's Tale on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4700460/Arthurs_Tale/
